remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence in one of the Village of Lancaster's most coveted locations, just a short stroll from the Village's shops, dining, and amenities. A grand, expansive front porch sets an elegant tone and opens to a gracious foyer with abundant closet space and classic wainscoting. The foyer flows seamlessly into a generous family room and formal dining room, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The oversized eat-in kitchen features rich oak cabinetry and ample space to gather. Convenient first-floor laundry and a full bath add everyday ease. Upstairs, three spacious bedrooms, a full bath, and an additional overflow closet provide exceptional storage. Significant updates offer peace of mind, including windows, oven (2024), roof (2016), drain tile and basement waterproofing by Frank's (2018), sump pump (2018), electrical, hot water tank, and furnace. A private backyard retreat and two-car garage complete this exceptional offering. Bring your personal design vision and make it your own!
